messages:
pat: Quick ops thread after the postmortem. We need a compact canary + rollback playbook that engineers can attach to any feature flag PR. Goal: one-page checklist + deterministic controller semantics. Owners + rough ETAs by EOD.

viv: Good. Keep it short: (1) preflight canary, (2) staged ramp, (3) cohort-aware signals, (4) deterministic rollback + re-ramp rules.

omar: Suggest we publish a small JSON schema teams can paste into their PR description with required fields and a link to the controller simulator. That will make reviews consistent.

tia: I drafted a checklist and a minimal schema. Sharing here for feedback. The checklist is deliberately tiny so reviewers actually use it.

pat: paste the checklist please.

tia: CHECKLIST (for PR description):
- preflight: run local simulated rollout via simulator endpoint and attach results (link)
- canary: include synthetic probe that exercises downstream services in a smoke run
- ramp plan: staged percentages + min_hold_minutes (example: [1,10,50], 30m)
- rollback criteria: require two signals (5xx, biz-failure, canary_fail) in same cohort within window OR single severe 5xx (>5%)
- blast_radius_cap_pct: required for class=critical flags (default 15%)
- post-rollback: blackout re-ramp for 4h unless SRE-approved

viv: Love it. Can we add a tiny example schema so product knows the minimal fields?

tia: Example schema snippet (for PR):
```
{"flag":"<name>", "class":"critical|normal", "ramp":"[1,10,50]", "min_hold_minutes":"30", "blast_radius_cap_pct":"15", "canary_probe":"<url or description>", "sim_results":"<link>"}
```

omar: Two implementation notes we should include in the playbook: (A) simulator must run cohort-aware metrics so reviewers can see per-region decisions, (B) controller should expose a deterministic "why rolled back" reason code so oncall can triage faster.

pat: Action items: 1) tia to publish the one-page playbook + add schema template to docs (owner: tia, ETA: 2025-12-05). 2) omar to add a "simulate" endpoint to rollout controller that accepts the schema and returns deterministic stage decisions + reason codes (owner: omar, ETA: 2025-11-28). 3) viv to update PR template and ship a bot that warns if the schema is missing (owner: viv, ETA: 2025-12-02). I'll coordinate the first wave of flag owners to try it next week.

ops-bot: INC-2025-043: follow-ups added [tia, omar, viv]. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2025-043

omar: Also adding a small telemetry panel template that shows: current exposure pct, cohort deltas for 5xx and biz-fail, canary probe pass rate, and last controller decision code. Will attach to PR simulator output.

tia: I'll make the playbook copy short and include a "how to interpret simulator output" section (1 paragraph). We'll iterate after the first batch.

pat: Great. Quick sync Friday 9am to review doc + simulator demo. Thanks everyone.
